localChanges: Package.swift: macOS and iOS minimum deployment targets raised to 26 to match SIFT and select a Metal language standard supporting upstream C++17 shader syntax.

Cmlx: preserve full-width sizes, offsets and signed strides across operations, traversal, BLAS and Metal dispatch; use sift_checked_cast at narrower host/kernel ABI boundaries and retain the actual uint32/int64 generated-shader size contracts.
Cmlx: honor small-power threadgroup budgets; explicitly preserve bfloat copy assignment and remove unused base-method parameter names, with matching framework headers.
MLX: preserve caller isolation in async random/device/stream task-local scopes using nonisolated(nonsending); remove an unused mask-fill binding.
MLXNN: preserve both unset and explicitly nil Optional property-wrapper states while retaining non-Optional initialization failures; remove an exhaustive-switch dead default.
